name: Abhishek Infraventures Limited
about: Abhishek Infraventures Limited engages in the construction and infrastructure project-related activities in India. The company builds, constructs, owns, operates, maintains, manages, controls, and administers earth works, farmhouses, parks, gardens, houses, duplex apartments, retail stores, shopping centers, market yards, cinema theatres, and studios, as well as commercial, residential or industrial building complexes. It also undertakes underground cables, railway tracks and sidings, airports, shipyards, culverts, channels, and various power projects; and constructs transmission lines, as well as irrigation schemes and other projects directly or indirectly associated with infrastructural facilities. In addition, it is involved in business and profession related to land dealings, buildings, farms, estates, properties, and areas and sites. The company was formerly known as Executive Stock Broking Services Limited and changed its name to Abhishek Infraventures Limited in September 2013. Abhishek Infraventures Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
